rules.title: Thermoset (EPDM) single-ply roof minimum slope
rules.intent: Ensure positive drainage on thermoset single-ply (EPDM) membrane roofs to prevent ponding and premature membrane failure.
evidence_required: Roof plan and section details showing design slope of at least 1/4:12 (2%)
Drainage plan or roof drain layout demonstrating positive drainage
Manufacturer's installation instructions confirming acceptable slope range

rules.title: Thermoset (EPDM) single-ply roof material standards
rules.intent: Ensure thermoset single-ply roof coverings meet recognized material specifications for durability and weather resistance.
evidence_required: Product data sheet or manufacturer specification identifying compliance with ASTM D4637 or ASTM D5019
Third-party test report or certification of conformance to the cited ASTM standard
Roofing material submittal stamped/approved for the specified roof assembly

rules.title: Thermoset (EPDM) single-ply roof installation per chapter and manufacturer instructions
rules.intent: Ensure thermoset single-ply roof systems are installed consistent with code provisions and the manufacturer's tested system to maintain warranty and performance.
evidence_required: Manufacturer's printed installation instructions submitted with the roofing package
Installer certification or training credential from the membrane manufacturer (if required by manufacturer)
Roof assembly detail drawings showing seams, terminations, flashings, and fasteners per manufacturer specifications
Inspection records or special inspection report verifying installation per manufacturer's instructions

rules.title: Thermoplastic (TPO/PVC) single-ply roof minimum slope
rules.intent: Ensure positive drainage on thermoplastic single-ply membrane roofs (TPO/PVC) to prevent ponding water and protect the membrane.
evidence_required: Roof plan and section details showing design slope of at least 1/4:12 (2%)
Drainage / roof drain layout confirming positive drainage to drains or scuppers
Manufacturer's installation instructions confirming acceptable slope range

rules.title: Thermoplastic (TPO/PVC) single-ply roof material standards
rules.intent: Ensure thermoplastic single-ply roof coverings meet recognized ASTM material specifications for the specific membrane chemistry (PVC, KEE, or TPO).
evidence_required: Product data sheet or manufacturer specification identifying compliance with ASTM D4434 (PVC), D6754 (KEE), or D6878 (TPO)
Third-party test report or listing showing conformance to the cited ASTM standard
Roofing material submittal stamped/approved for the specified roof assembly

rules.title: Thermoplastic (TPO/PVC) single-ply roof installation per chapter and manufacturer instructions
rules.intent: Ensure thermoplastic single-ply roof systems are installed consistent with code provisions and the manufacturer's tested system to achieve weather-tight performance.
evidence_required: Manufacturer's printed installation instructions submitted with the roofing package
Installer certification from the membrane manufacturer (if required)
Roof assembly detail drawings showing welded seams, terminations, flashings, and attachment per manufacturer specifications
Inspection records or special inspection report verifying installation per manufacturer's instructions
